Frequently Asked Questions

Why Maven instead of Gradle?
Maven is more common in enterprise Spring teams. The wrapper ensures consistent builds.
Does it include Spring Security / OAuth2?
No — the template is a clean REST API base. Add `spring-boot-starter-security` after generation.
What about Spring Data JPA / Hibernate?
The template includes the dependencies. Entity/repository examples are in src/main/java.
Can I use this with GraalVM native images?
Spring Boot 3 supports GraalVM. Add the native profile and build with `./mvnw -Pnative native:compile`.
